reports.notes: Relayed from Hadron's Discord. The game is 32-bit, and Hadron then built DXMT for 64-bit games only, so it rendered through Wine's own Direct3D 11 (wined3d on OpenGL on Zink).
reports.followUp: Hadron 0.3.3 runs 32-bit Direct3D 10 and 11 games through DXMT; a retest is pending.

links.title: 32-bit Direct3D 10/11 games run through wined3d, not DXMT
